title: WB-F1 blind audit set
description: rounds/RNN/audit-set.json, written by engine/steps/owner-waits.ts (09a) before any answer and reused on re-entry: up to 4 pairs seeded from every pair judged this round (key audit:<round>), positions shuffled (auditpos:<pair>). left / right are display ids (labels.json labels, BASE, AN1, AN2), never slot ids or the decoy. split = seededSplit(pair ids, freeze seed, 'labels:split', calibration.audit_visible); label = the blind-label id in calibration/labels.json; pair = the judged pair it was drawn from. The UI ignores split, label and pair.
